name: Mocertatug rezetecan
summary: Mocertatug rezetecan (Mo-Rez, GSK5733584, HS-20089) is a B7-H4 ADC carrying a topoisomerase I payload, licensed from Hansoh in 2023 for the world outside Greater China. The lead pivotal trial is BEHOLD-Endometrial01 (NCT07286331, 600 patients). It compares Mo-Rez with chemotherapy in endometrial cancer after platinum and immunotherapy, with primary completion on 2028-02-29 and ORR by BICR as the primary endpoint. B7-H4 is expressed in more than 95% of recurrent endometrial tumours, so the trial enrols without a biomarker cut. Price anchor: Trodelvy's CMS Part B figure of $82,521 per beneficiary (2024), the same anchor the book uses for puxitatug samrotecan, a rival B7-H4 ADC in the same disease, and for sac-TMT. Uptake anchor: the 15% of US second-line patients who took on-label immunotherapy, the last novel second-line entrant (Coleman et al. 2023, Flatiron). The ramp is the book's Enhertu fit.

therapy_mode.source: NCT07286331 (BEHOLD-Endometrial01): ADC dosed every cycle against chemotherapy. BEHOLD-1 (NCT06431594) doses 4.8 mg/kg every three weeks until progression.
therapy_mode.note: Oncology treated to progression, so chronic per house convention.

list_price_per_patient.source: python3 /tmp/claude-0/price/lookup.py demand Trodelvy: Part B 2024, $272,318,588 over 3,300 beneficiaries = $82,521 per beneficiary. The same anchor is on the Puxitatug Samrotecan, Sacituzumab Tirumotecan and AZD5335 seeds (lookup.py seed).
list_price_per_patient.note: JUDGEMENT. No ADC is marketed in second-line endometrial cancer. The on-label second-line incumbents are pembrolizumab plus lenvatinib and dostarlimab, but immunotherapy now sits in the first line, and BEHOLD-Endometrial01 enrols after it against chemotherapy. Trodelvy is used because it is the book's convention for a topo-I ADC in a solid tumour, and it keeps Mo-Rez on the same price as puxitatug (B7-H4 ADC, endometrial) and sac-TMT (endometrial after platinum and IO). Case against: Jemperli, GSK's own endometrial drug, is at $80,337 per beneficiary (lookup.py demand Jemperli, Part B 2024), which is almost the same. Enhertu, at $69,140, would be 16% lower.

gross_to_net_pct.source: House convention on a CMS per-beneficiary price (backend/gross_to_net.py; halving lands at a median 96% of CMS negotiated net prices), as carried on the puxitatug and AZD5335 seeds.
gross_to_net_pct.note: Net is 50% of list. Direction checked: this is the share OFF list. Case against: Part B drugs are paid at ASP plus 6%, and ASP is already net. On that basis the Sacituzumab Tirumotecan and Ifinatamab Deruxtecan seeds take only 0.0566 off, which would roughly double net revenue. The book is inconsistent here, and this file follows the brief.

discontinuation_pct.unit: share of treated stock stopping per year
discontinuation_pct.source: Hansoh ESMO 2025 release, phase 2 HS-20089 in platinum-resistant ovarian cancer: median PFS 6.4 months at 4.8 mg/kg (https://www.hspharm.com/news/news-detail-513373.htm). At a constant hazard, 1 - 0.5^(12/6.4) = 0.727.
discontinuation_pct.note: The median-correct constant-hazard form is used, as on the I-DXd and sac-TMT seeds. The brief's 1 - exp(-12/6.4) would give 0.847, because it treats the median as a mean. The median comes from PROC, since no endometrial PFS for Mo-Rez was found; phase 1 endometrial ORR was 67% at 4.8 mg/kg (OncLive, BEHOLD-1). Case against: endometrial responses may be more durable than in PROC, which would mean a lower rate. For context, real-world second-line chemotherapy lasts a median of only 3.2 months (Coleman et al. 2023, doi:10.36469/001c.87853).

forecast_start_year.source: NCT07286331 primary completion 2028-02-29 (book trials table, clinicaltrials_v2, fetched 2026-09-24)
forecast_start_year.note: Readout in early 2028, filing in mid-2028, launch in 2029, so 2030 is the first full year. Case for 2029: an ORR primary endpoint could support an early filing. Ovarian (NCT07286266, PROC) completes in December 2029 and is not modelled.

exus_multiple.source: GSK FY2025 annual report (0001654954-26-000892), Jemperli: US 647, EU 159, ROW 55 (book asset_revenue_regions). (159 + 55) / 647 = 0.331.
exus_multiple.note: JUDGEMENT on the comparator. Jemperli is GSK's own infused endometrial oncology medicine. Mo-Rez's ex-US sales will exclude Greater China, which Hansoh keeps; Jemperli's small China contribution sits inside ROW. Case against: Jemperli's EU first-line launch is younger than its US one, so a mature split would probably be higher. Zejula's split is 0.91, but it is an oral drug that is past its peak in the US.

economics_share.source: GSK press release, December 2023, 'GSK enters exclusive license agreement with Hansoh for HS-20089' (https://www.gsk.com/en-gb/media/press-releases/gsk-enters-exclusive-license-agreement-with-hansoh-for-hs-20089/): $85mm upfront, up to $1.485bn in success-based milestones, and tiered royalties on net sales outside mainland China, Hong Kong, Macau and Taiwan. The GSK 6-K of 2026-09-14 (0001654954-26-008321) names Hansoh as GSK's licensor for the sister ADC.
economics_share.note: Licence: Hansoh, exclusive, ex-Greater China, and GSK books all sales. No profit split exists. The royalty rates are not disclosed in the release or in the GSK filings the book holds, so no deduction is modelled. Case against: tiered royalties, plausibly low double digits at peak, would cut GSK's economic share below 1.0 by that rate. Unmodelled milestones of up to $1.485bn also remain.

prevalence.note: lookup.py pool 'Endometrial Neoplasms': 26,000 (SEER-based advanced or recurrent pool), the figure on the Jemperli, puxitatug and sac-TMT seeds.

eligible_pct.source: Coleman et al., J Health Econ Outcomes Res 2023 (doi:10.36469/001c.87853, PMC10613433): 1,031 of 1,961 US Flatiron patients who started a first line for advanced or recurrent endometrial cancer went on to a second (53%). The same value is on the Sacituzumab Tirumotecan seed for TroFuse-005, the same post-platinum, post-IO population.
eligible_pct.note: No B7-H4 cut is applied. GSK reports B7-H4 expression in more than 95% of recurrent or advanced endometrial tumours in BEHOLD-1, and the phase 3 enrols without selection (OncLive, BEHOLD-1 data). The puxitatug seed's unsourced 0.45 'B7-H4 share' conflicts with this. That is about 13,780 patients a year. Case against: 2013 to 2022 data predate first-line IO, which may change the share that reaches a second line.

penetration_peak_pct.unit: share of the eligible untreated pool per year
penetration_peak_pct.source: Coleman et al. 2023 (doi:10.36469/001c.87853): on-label immunotherapy (pembrolizumab alone or with lenvatinib, and dostarlimab), the last novel second-line entrant, reached 15% of second-line patients (151 of 1,031) in US Flatiron data from 2013 to 2022.
penetration_peak_pct.note: JUDGEMENT that Mo-Rez captures what the last novel second-line class captured. This is probably a lower bound: the window includes years before the 2019 and 2021 approvals, so the mature share was higher. Case against: sac-TMT (TroFuse-005 positive, filing now) and puxitatug will contest the same post-IO line, and I-DXd-class ADCs may follow. The sac-TMT seed carries 0.19, but that figure is solved from an analyst peak, not measured.

ramp_steepness.source: Book's Enhertu launch fit (on the AZD5335, puxitatug and sac-TMT seeds): CMS Part B beneficiaries of 864, 1,904, 4,841, 7,105 and 8,410 over 2020 to 2024 (lookup.py demand Enhertu confirms the counts)
ramp_steepness.note: Reused from the closest modelled competitors: puxitatug (B7-H4 ADC, endometrial) and sac-TMT (endometrial, same line). Case against: Enhertu opened a new segment, while Mo-Rez may enter a line with one or two ADCs already launched.

ramp_midpoint_year.note: Reused from the puxitatug and sac-TMT endometrial seeds.
